question.text: Nitric acid can be obtained from ammonia via the formations of the intermediate compounds

solution.text:
Ostwald process of for manufacture of nitric acid, $4 \mathrm{NH}_{3}+\mathrm{SO}_{2} \frac{\mathrm{Pt} \text { gauge }}{800-900^{\circ} \mathrm{C}} \underset{\text { nitric oxide }}{4 \mathrm{NO}}+6 \mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$
$$
\Delta H=-21.5 \mathrm{kcal}
$$
$2 \mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O}_{2} \stackrel{50^{\circ} \mathrm{C}}{\longrightarrow} \quad 2 \mathrm{NO}_{2}$
$4 \mathrm{NO}_{2}+2 \mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}+\mathrm{O}_{2} \longrightarrow \underset{\text { nitric acid }}{4 \mathrm{HNO}_{3}}$
